boundary_note: The columns name months, not changeover days. December 1 and September 1 are approximate selection boundaries, not measured dates.
trigger_note: The charged row reads "enemy freeze time (immediately after a charged move activates)". It does not say whose charged move. Counting only the player's charged attacks is this project's reading, kept as the default; any_charged is the other reading.

rows.charged: 敵の硬直時間 (ゲージ技発動直後) | 2.5秒 | 4秒 | 3.5秒
rows.faint: 敵の硬直時間 (瀕死による交代直後) | 3.5秒 | 6秒 | 3.5秒
rows.manual_switch: 敵の硬直時間 (手動交代直後) | 3.5秒 | 6秒 | 4.5秒

cwizz1.quote: 7 turns after any charged move or switch
cwizz1.quote_basis: Excerpt preserved in docs/rocket-pokemon.md section 4; live thread could not be retrieved.
cwizz1.own_switch_note: The same research notes describe your own switch as effectively 6 turns. Stored as 6; no voluntary switches are simulated.

timer.charged_quote: 7s are added per charge move used
timer.interpretation: Use these approximate measurements as exact model parameters. Each resolved charged attack, on either side, including shielded attacks, extends the turn deadline. No animation turns are added.
